title: Tessera per-agent evaluation set
description: A curated subset of the failure catalogue bound to an agent package. Curated in AGIR · Curation; the registry's `eval_set` slug resolves to this manifest. The gate (min_pass_rate) is the release bar: an agent cannot go live until its set passes.

slug.description: Stable identifier; must equal the file stem and match an agent's `eval_set`.

agent_id.description: The agent this set is bound to. Omitted for the shared/global catalogue set.

case_ids.description: Failure-catalogue case ids (file stems under eval/failures/). Every id must exist.

min_pass_rate.description: Release bar: a run below this pass rate fails the eval-gate (non-zero exit; not live).
